Editable Indian Menu Design

Editable Indian Menu Design

$50-51 USD

Open

Posted 5 minutes ago

•

Ends in 6 days

$50-51 USD

Paid on delivery

I’ve already chosen a printable menu template from BrandPacks and now need it customised in Adobe Illustrator so I can update it easily in the future. The restaurant is Indian, so the layout and ornamentation should keep a warm, traditional feel—think subtle ethnic motifs rather than anything too modern or rustic. Content structure I need incorporated: • Starters • Dosa section • Thalis • Main Course – clearly split into Veg & Non-Veg • Breads • Drinks / Desserts I’ll supply the wording and prices once the basic grid is in place. Feel free to suggest a colour scheme that complements authentic Indian décor; I’m open as long as it supports the traditional tone. Deliverables: • Layered, fully editable .ai file (CMYK, 300 dpi) • Print-ready PDF with crop marks and bleeds • Web-optimised JPG or PNG for online menus I also need it in a format so I can edit certain parts on canva. Please retain the template’s paragraph styles and master page setup so I can make quick edits later. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you have about fonts or imagery.

The key here is not just making the menu look authentic Indian, but keeping the Illustrator file clean enough that you can update dishes and prices later without breaking the template structure. I’d customize the BrandPacks layout with a warm traditional treatment, keep the section flow clear, and set up the final files so print and quick future edits stay straightforward. I work with print-ready menu and marketing layouts regularly, including Illustrator-based files that need proper layers, CMYK setup, bleed/crop marks, and an editable handoff instead of a flattened design.
